name: Aba (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of yellow and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Aba (a green shield with a crescent, a star and ears of grain, with a crown and yellow mantling) above the name ABA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
